Can ChatGPT help you improve your UPSC Mains answers?

AIR 100 Sattwik Satyakam Devta shares how he used ChatGPT during his Sociology preparation to create notes, prepare model answers for PYQs and get his answers evaluated.

He also used the feedback to identify weaknesses, understand how to improve his answers and collect relevant examples to revise and incorporate into later answers.

Here’s a practical look at how one UPSC ranker used AI as part of his answer-writing process.
